figure_judgment: Readable common axes. Median waveform bands remain visually close while charge-conditioned PSD bands remain filled. Global PSD CDF and fixed HGB do not capture the conditional discrepancy.
judgment: Changing only the head latent base gives a small validation likelihood improvement but does not restore charge-conditioned PSD bands. Full-minus-head PSD perturbations are small; prioritize a matched head fine-tune with explicit conditional CDF and occupancy constraints. The fixed two-feature HGB near chance is not evidence of PSD equivalence.
boundaries: The completed metrics live under completion_001; original top-level partial metrics and native failure are preserved.
One seed-interface validation failure preceded any GMM initialization or EM; completed actual fits remain two.
PSD projection differences are within-domain residual contributions, not error against real data or a unique physical cause.
Two-feature classifier definitions, selected positions and predictions were checked, but original transformed matrices were not saved.
Single acquisition and artificial groups; bootstrap conditions on fitted classifiers.
GMM8 is chosen by internal validation likelihood, not accepted as a correct PSD or G4 response.
The R3B loss-history comparison alone is not causal because its representation and model differed.
